analysis: post-hoc exploratory one-step profile transition lookup
primary_metric: mean per-trial ROC AUC with 5000-resample percentile bootstrap over trials
attacker: For each target operation, use only the immediately preceding visible storage tag. Profile labeled sessions map that tag to the next hot/cold label with a single prior pseudo-observation; the first target operation uses the profile class prior.
target_labels: logical address in configured hot set [0] versus remaining addresses
attacker_training: first half of each trial's whole sessions, with driver labels; target sessions are disjoint and labels are used only for scoring

configuration.ci_method: percentile bootstrap with 5000 resamples over 30 per-trial AUCs

limitations: This analysis was selected after seeing the primary result and reuses the same synthetic Markov sessions; it is post-hoc, not an independent replication. The attack is a simple profile-based lookup, not a reproduction of a published attack. Near-chance scores do not prove cryptographic security or exclude other attacks.
analysis_source_state: The analysis module was uncommitted at execution; its exact SHA-256 is recorded in source_sha256.
